notes: Release builds without profiler. No builds, tests or profiling concurrent with timed samples. Host services remain active; frequency not fixed.
Pool A/B predates numeric resolver patch and isolates only conditional pool notifications.
Spin A/B uses the unchanged baseline with RSLOOP_WAKE_SPIN_US=50 versus 0. Default was not changed.
Final matrix includes both patches; seven measured runs share a process after two warmups. Not independent paired evidence.
Raw request latencies omitted; process-run measurements retained. This compact bundle is not input to check_regression.py.

pool_ab.method:
Interleave baseline/candidate wheels in fresh workload-matrix processes.

Each process performs two discarded warmups and one measured run. Every run
uses 16 connections and 500 requests per connection. This supplements the
standard sustained matrix with independent, alternating A/B process blocks.
